test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is - **Contencious**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The three correctly spelled words are - Prevaricate, Refute, Revere
 
• The word that is misspelled is 1)** Contencious.**
 
• The correct spelling is "**contentious**," which means **causing or likely to cause an argument; controversial**.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is 1) **Contencious.**
